name: get_workload_status
description: Summarize a Deployment: desired, ready, updated and available replicas, conditions, current revision, and whether it is managed by GitOps. Read-only.

name: plan_scale_deployment
description: Plan a replica change for a Deployment without changing anything. Runs preflight checks and returns a single-use plan_id, the diff and an expiry. The change is only made by apply_scale_deployment with the same arguments and plan_id.
